item.title: Pull request #2940 created
item.description:
create-rendered-diff.xq

Due to the lack of local DeltaXML licenses, I have created a poor man’s XQuery diff script. It’s not that far from the professional rendering:

Local rendering

DeltaXML rendering

The script (which uses a lot of 4.0 magic) works with recent versions of BaseX, but if the proc:system call is replaced, it should be runnable with any other current XQuery processor.

I’ll merge it in a minute (@ndw hope that’s ok); feedback is welcome.
